Title: Azure Monitor for containers now supports large-scale clusters

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for containers now supports the monitoring of large-scale clusters up to 1,000 nodes and 100 node pools. This supports comes along with Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) support for large-scale clusters (via multiple node pools).

Learn more about Azure Monitor for containers
